create_GroundedSAMPerception: create a GroundedSAMPerception instance with a custom vocabulary list for object detection
predict_GroundedSAMPerception: run GroundedSAMPerception predict on an Observations object to get semantic and instance segmentation maps
reset_vocab_GroundedSAMPerception: reset the custom vocabulary of a GroundedSAMPerception instance to detect new object classes
segment_GroundedSAMPerception: use the segment method to generate SAM masks from bounding boxes on an image
review_GroundedSAMPerception: review the GroundedSAMPerception class that combines GroundingDINO detection with MobileSAM segmentation
